_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: The redirect URI must match the registered one character for character, including a trailing slash. HubSpot is stricter about this than most.
Read scopes only. A CRM an agent can write to is a CRM that can be quietly corrupted by a task that misread a field.
Scopes must also be enabled on the app in HubSpot's console; requesting one that is not enabled there fails at the consent screen, not at the token exchange.

rate_limits.note: Per-app and per-account limits, commonly around 100 requests per 10 seconds. Search endpoints are lower and are the ones that trip.
